planned_final_lock: V4-13 after all applicable training and calibration
primary_endpoint: Correct final confirmed goal/task within error-risk and interaction budgets; frozen-capture simulated submission is distinct from robot completion
primary_comparison: Full vs B4_aux shared-query with matched data/LoRA/binding/parameter budget and shared fixed inquiry contract
current_comparison_scope: Full same-checkpoint confirmation-gate engineering ablation only; not architecture comparison

risk.formal_basis: one-sided 95% upper bound on scene-any-error as conservative gate; also report episode-any-error and submission-conditional error
risk.assumptions: independent representative scene/task clusters; equal locked initialization/scenario composition; unavailable capacity is a blocker
risk.multiplicity: Primary Full risk claim has a single prespecified one-sided bound; other method bounds descriptive unless a joint alpha allocation is locked at V4-13.

gain_status: provisional design target, not tuned to formal outcomes; finalize effect and sample assumptions using development only

statistics.unit: paired scene/task clusters; keep all initializations and scenarios together
statistics.effect_interval: paired scene-cluster bootstrap after adequate independent cluster count
statistics.multiplicity: one prespecified primary comparison; secondary/ablation results descriptive or Holm-corrected within declared family

sample_size.independent_unit: scene/task cluster, not augmented condition or training seed
sample_size.risk_model: independent scene-any-error Bernoulli bound; conservative for average episode risk; independence and sampling assumptions required
sample_size.upper_bound_caveat: illustration only: present episodes share only two scene groups

latency.total: from private scorer change time to first correct updated confirmation; unresolved censored at horizon
latency.identifiable_anchor: trusted explicit public goal declaration only; no such anchor in present raw-noise captures
latency.conditional_latency: report only where anchor exists; publish coverage and censoring, never relabel noisy agreement as identified truth
latency.future_anchor_options: A validated probabilistic public change-evidence rule under explicit channel assumptions may be preregistered; label it operational, not noiseless truth. None is validated here.

freeze_requirements: same new binding mechanism for B3/B4/Full
shared fixed inquiry for structure comparison
adequate new independent heldout scene capacity
full VLM and LIBERO-action interface gates when claiming execution
write immutable V4-13 lock before one-time formal test opening
